Start: 2013-10-25  
Add 42 weeks = 42 × 7 = 294 days  
Add 2 days → total 296 days  

2013-10-25 + 296 days:  
Days in 2013 after Oct 25: 6 (Oct) + 30 (Nov) + 31 (Dec) = 67 days  
296 − 67 = 229 days into 2014  

2014 is not leap year, so:  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30 = 181 days  
229 − 181 = 48 days into July → 2014-07-18  

FINAL_ANSWER: 2014-07-18
